usage.callShape: POST https://stablephone.dev/api/call with JSON body {phone_number, task, ...optional}. Pays $0.54 USDC via x402 (Base) or mpp.

inputExample.task: This is a test call from the MasterKey registry QA system. Briefly greet John, say this is an automated verification call, and then say goodbye and hang up.
inputExample.first_sentence: Hi John, this is an automated test call from MasterKey registry QA.

usage.outputShape: body.success (true), body.call_id (string, use to track), body.message
quirks: DELIVERY HUMAN-CONFIRMED 2026-06-09: the user (John, +15555550123) actually received the output — an inbound phone call from +15076072903 and two "MasterKey QA test SMS" texts — confirming end-to-end real-world delivery, not just a paid 200.
OUTWARD: places a REAL outbound AI phone call. Use only a real, consented number.
phone_number must match ^\+1\d{10}$ (US/Canada E.164, +1 then 10 digits). Required field along with task (1-4000 chars).
Returns 403 if the number is on the Do-Not-Call (DNC) list — do NOT retry DNC numbers.
Call is QUEUED on success (message: 'Call successfully queued.'), not completed synchronously; the call_id tracks it.
Status + transcript polling at GET /api/call/:id is SIWX-gated — only the same wallet that paid can poll. The pay call itself needs no auth.

Optional fields: from (caller ID, must own the number), first_sentence, voice, max_duration (1-30 min), wait_for_greeting, record, model (base|turbo), transfer_phone_number, voicemail_action (hangup|leave_message|ignore), voicemail_message, metadata.
usage.guide: POST to https://stablephone.dev/api/call with at minimum {"phone_number":"+1XXXXXXXXXX","task":"what the AI should say/do on the call"}. Pay $0.54 USDC (x402/Base or mpp) — no API key needed. On success you get {success:true, call_id} immediately and the call is queued, then placed to the number. To read the outcome/transcript, poll GET /api/call/:id, which is SIWX-gated (only the paying wallet can poll). This is a real outbound phone call, so confirm consent/correct number before calling and never retry numbers that return 403 (DNC).
